conditions.selection: One barrel per annual fair. Overall policy maximizes total; alternate recommendation policy maximizes recommendation count, breaks ties by total then serial. No diversity bonus.
conditions.recommendation: Judge score >=80 and strictly higher than each of three fixed rivals.
conditions.ranking: Competition rank 1 + number of strictly higher rival totals, rounded scores; ties share rank.
conditions.chronological: Four years with real 12-month aging between optional fairs. Prepared starting ages differ; no capital, cash, maintenance, turnover or subjective motivation simulation.

limits: Five fixed Gaussian taste preferences, three selected annually. New two preferences are experiment hypotheses, not human tasting evidence.
Winning recipe concentration over 216 immutable profiles is diagnostic; no all-recipe optimum proof.
Recommendations on/off do not alter scores, ranks or overall policy choice. They only add an alternate record and an alternate selection criterion.
Potential award coverage is a union of alternatives, not an award count one entry can receive.
No sampling effect on flavor or score; none/small can change remaining liquid/bottle count but not selected taste under this policy.
Fixed rivals never evolve. No prediction of human entry motivation, next-batch desire or inheritance.
Ages stop at 120 months; sell/replace is needed to continue when any barrel reaches bound.
strategyInterpretation: Same prepared barrels, unchanged age between panels; no equal-capital comparison. All arrays align with years. Potential coverage is union across alternative barrels, not actual awards from the one entry. Panel identities resolve via comparisons conditions.

headlines.sampleEffect: none/small selects the same barrel and produces the same scores/ranks in every paired chronological run; liquid/bottle counts can differ.
